Content:
## QueuedInput

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Models`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Represents a single item in the chat input queue. Wraps a `ChatMessageContent` with a unique identifier.

### Constructor
```csharp
public QueuedInput(ChatMessageContent message)
```
- `message`: The `ChatMessageContent` to queue
- Automatically generates a GUID `Id`

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Id` | `string` | Unique identifier (GUID, read-only) |
| `Role` | `AuthorRole` | The message author role (derived from `Message.Role`) |
| `Message` | `ChatMessageContent` | The chat message content |

### Usage
```csharp
var content = new ChatMessageContent(AuthorRole.User, "Hello, analyze this image");
var input = new QueuedInput(content);

// Access properties
Console.WriteLine(input.Id);      // "a1b2c3d4-..."
Console.WriteLine(input.Role);    // User
Console.WriteLine(input.Message.Content); // "Hello, analyze this image"
```

### Related
- `IIterationService` - Processes queued inputs
- `ChatMessageContent` - Semantic Kernel chat message type
- `AuthorRole` - Semantic Kernel role enumeration
